text.content:
One of the two voices on every screen.

Headquarters: N54 HQ, Downtown
Industry: News and broadcast vid
In Night City: With WNS, controls nearly all broadcast TV and most of the news

N54 and WNS between them own the airwaves and the cable lines in Night City, and most other news outlets buy their content. They decide, with the other megacorps, what gets covered and what gets buried.

Gig hooks

  • A reporter at N54 has a story their bosses won't run, and wants it to reach a pirate station.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.30
